title: Azure Firewall (Microsoft Azure)
body:
# Azure Firewall Network Security Lab

This lab focuses on strengthening **network security** by deploying and configuring **Azure Firewall** to manage inbound and outbound traffic.

## Objective

The objective is to build a **secure virtual environment** with clearly defined access rules and strict traffic control.

## Lab Scope

The lab includes:

- Creating an **Azure Virtual Network (VNet)**
- Deploying **Virtual Machines (VMs)**
- Configuring **routing**
- Setting up **Azure Firewall rules**
- Configuring **DNS**
- Enforcing strict **inbound and outbound traffic control**

The resulting environment demonstrates how Azure Firewall can be used to control and secure network communication within an Azure infrastructure.
